info.title: Volter Identity
info.description: id.volter.ai: Better Auth 1.7.5 with the plugins volter-ai/identity worker/src/auth.ts configures (its /api/auth routes, as better-auth's openAPI plugin generates them), the product organizations API of worker/src/product.ts, and the discovery routes of worker/src/index.ts.
